problems: build()/neighbours(): the tall/low reveal crops firewall-w0 to four columns and paints it on the front facade at x=140..143 in the left test and x=432..435 in the right test. It reads as trim beside windows, not an exposed, coped party-wall plane above the lower roof. The separate firewall_surface() proof is not used to solve this scene.

build()/critic_layouts(): extra depth is filled north of a complete ridge cap, leaving a heavy transverse ridge as an internal seam. The L-corner valley is an opaque square at local (48,96), with mismatched courses and no continuous L-wing gutter. roof-hip-end is not exercised by any critic scene.

ground_shadows(): rotating and repeating the stepped w1 mask along the east receiver produces periodic notches down the straight side of the five-storey building. Wide south masks repeat the same defect. Maximum-alpha union prevents double opacity but does not correct the silhouette.

critic_layouts().add(): generic central placement is used for skylights on all roof kinds. In north-row and market gable w2 buildings the skylight spans the central ridge at local x=48 instead of lying on one pitched plane. Rectangular canvas containment is not a sufficient receiving-surface check.
Required scene files exist and native placement/scale are correct, but their visual roof-join and firewall results fail. Technical checks cannot override these failures.
compose.py.fix: Use explicit roof receiving planes and compatible junctions: extend the correct slope beyond the cap, align a valley/gutter with an actual L intersection, and demonstrate hip-end termination. Composite the redrawn firewall as a readable side plane in both tall/low orientations. Assemble continuous south/east shadows from drawn masks without repeating terminal notches. Mount skylights wholly on compatible slopes. Rebuild the same 1x/3x/greyscale proofs and inspect joins at 4x/8x.
